Method.Name: findByFeedbackId

AxTableField.Name: FeedbackId
AxTableField.HelpText: Generated on the handheld - also the idempotency key, so a resend cannot record it twice.
AxTableField.Label: Feedback ID

AxTableField.Name: Screen
AxTableField.HelpText: The app screen the feedback was sent from.
AxTableField.Label: Screen

AxTableField.Name: Status
AxTableField.HelpText: Shown to the worker in the app, with the reply.
AxTableField.Label: Status

AxTableField.Name: Response
AxTableField.HelpText: Shown to the worker in the app under their feedback.
AxTableField.Label: Reply

AxTableField.Name: HasScreenshot
AxTableField.HelpText: The screenshot is a document attachment of this record (Attachments).
AxTableField.Label: Screenshot attached

AxTableField.Name: SelectedForExport
AxTableField.HelpText: Ticked records are what Export feedback downloads; with none ticked it downloads the list shown.
AxTableField.Label: Export

AxTableField.Name: Screenshot
AxTableField.HelpText: The screen the feedback was sent from, as the worker saw it (JPEG).
AxTableField.Label: Screenshot

AxTableField.Name: Logs
AxTableField.HelpText: The last lines of the app's own log when the feedback was sent.
AxTableField.Label: App log
